projection_method.description: How this module's functions were projected from LogicNodes (UPG-40). "templated_v1" = every function is a synthetic template carrying no recovered semantics. "ast_v1" = every function was derived from real AST signature data. "mixed_v1" = both, which is normal when one source file mixes AST-backed and regex-only extraction. Optional so modules written before UPG-40 stay valid; absent means templated_v1.
